bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears, now 3-1 after a Week 4 win over the Jets, will start backup quarterback Tyson Bagent again in Week 5 against the Packers as Caleb Williams continues to sit out with a hamstring injury, though his absence is not expected to last much longer . In other roster news, defensive end Marcus Davenport, who made his Bears debut in Week 4, will not play a second game with the organization , fueling speculation about a potential reunion with former Bears star Khalil Mack.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: Safety Brian Branch returned to practice this week as he works his way back from an Achilles injury, with head coach Dan Campbell expressing optimism about his status for Sunday's game against the Cardinals. packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story is the Packers' defense preparing to move forward without star linebacker Edgerrin Cooper, who was placed on injured reserve after a torn Achilles ended his season, with Green Bay signing LB Kristian Welch to the active roster and working out veterans like Deion Jones to fill the void. Meanwhile, the Packers are gearing up to host the Bears at Lambeau Field in Week 5, where they've won 15 of the last 18 meetings against the Bears at Lambeau Field , with Chicago expected to start QB Tyson Bagent in place of the injured Caleb Williams.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings signed veteran wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. to their practice squad on October 7 after his release from the New York Giants, a move that bolsters depth at the position while star receiver Justin Jefferson remains optimistic about returning from an ankle injury to play against the Saints .
